== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A gatestone is a tool used for spatial transmission, functioning as a method of instant teleportation. These objects vary in size and shape, often appearing as blue, shimmering lumps that resemble crushed glass or gritty balls of sand. To activate the stone's transport capabilities, a user must crush it, which results in the object being destroyed. This process allows an individual to return immediately to a specific location, a method that has been utilized by others to escape the world of [[Ghostwater]]. While they are more affordable than other spatial transport devices, they represent significant labor for high-level practitioners like [[Sages]] to produce and are not used lightly. Additionally, gatestones can be used to disrupt a [[spatial lock]] by stressing the local field through the act of throwing and breaking the stone.}}
